Objectively verify the cryptographic completion hash of an object against disk
state.

This command verifies that the verification_hash of a test_case or backlog_item matches
the actual cryptographic hash of its referenced artifacts on disk.

Flags:
    --organizer
      Execute composite execution organizer for multi-criteria test verification
    --topology <string> (default: sequential)
      Execution topology mode for organizer (sequential, concurrent, hybrid_dag)

  Verify a backlog item
  zqk system verify-completion BLI-123

Usage:
  zqk system verify-completion <object-id> [flags]

Flags:
      --organizer         Execute composite execution organizer for multi-criteria test verification
      --topology string   Execution topology mode for organizer (sequential, concurrent, hybrid_dag) (default "sequential")

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
